metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did northern part of Madagascar (between latitude of -12 to -15) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

data.raw_code: To answer this question, I need to: 1. Compare rainfall in Dec 2018-Jan 2019 vs long-term average for Dec-Jan from 2000-2019 2. Focus on northern Madagascar (latitude -12 to -15) 3. Use precipitation data (likely CHIRPS or similar) 4. Calculate average rainfall for both periods and compare Strategy: - Use CHIRPS daily precipitation data - Define region: northern Madagascar (-12 to -15 latitude) - Calculate total rainfall for Dec 2018-Jan 2019 - Calculate long-term average for Dec-Jan from 2000-2019 - Compare if recent period had less rain Potential issues: - No data in collection (C1) - No valid pixels after masking (C2) - Invalid calculation results (C3) I'll use CHIRPS and create proper geometry for the region. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define northern Madagascar region (latitude -12 to -15) const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([42.5, -15, 50.5, -12]); // Function to calculate total precipitation for Dec-Jan period function getPrecipitationTotal(startYear, endYear) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterBounds(region) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(12, 1, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(startYear, endYear, 'year')); return collection.sum().set('period', `${startYear}-${endYear}`); } // Get recent period (Dec 2018 - Jan 2019) const recentPeriod = getPrecipitationTotal(2018, 2019); // Get long-term average (Dec-Jan from 2000-2019, excluding 2018-2019) const longTermCollection = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterBounds(region) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(12, 1, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2000, 2019, 'year')); // Check collection sizes const recentSize = recentPeriod.bandNames().size().getInfo(); const longTermSize = longTermCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Recent period images: ${recentSize}`); console.log(`Long-term collection size: ${longTermSize}`); if (recentSize === 0 || longTermSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate long-term average const longTermAvg = longTermCollection.mean(); // Calculate mean precipitation values const recentMean = recentPeriod.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const longTermMean = longTermAvg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const recentCount = recentPeriod.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const longTermCount = longTermAvg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Recent period pixels: ${recentCount}`); console.log(`Long-term pixels: ${longTermCount}`); if (recentCount === 0 || longTermCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } console.log(`Recent (2018-19): ${recentMean?.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Long-term avg: ${longTermMean?.toFixed(2)} mm`); // Validate results if (recentMean === null || longTermMean === null || isNaN(recentMean) || isNaN(longTermMean) || recentMean < 0 || longTermMean < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare and output answer if (recentMean < longTermMean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
